layout: transform
name: invasion of azgol
mana cost: {B}{R}
types: battle siege
defense: 4
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker and loses 1 life.
triggered: when CARDNAME is defeated, exile it, then cast it transformed.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with four defense counters on it.

ALTERNATE

name: ashen reaper
types: creature zombie elemental
power toughness: 2/1
static: menace
triggered: at the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME if a permanent was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
